description: One question and one AI: that AI's answer word for word, exactly as stored, with the pages it cited, from the latest check or a given date. Quote it as that AI's words. Use it for "show me exactly what ChatGPT said" or "who did Perplexity recommend for the Comrades question?".

ai.description: The AI: chatgpt, claude, gemini or perplexity.

date.description: A check day, YYYY-MM-DD. Leave it out for the latest check.

question.description: The question: its id ("p03"), its number in the list ("3"), or words from it ("Comrades").

site.description: Which of your sites: its domain ("biotree.bio"), its id from list_my_sites ("biotree-bio") or its name. Leave it out when the person has one site.

name: ai_answer

message.description: When view is "none": what to tell the person.

result.description: named, with your address | named | your address given, not named | not named.

view.description: What this answer is; "none" for a question back, a plain no, or nothing there yet (see message).

title: What the AI said
